reviewed_by: Codex focused review for provider credential recovery
reason: The branch adds bounded systemd service credentials, typed locked-vault failures, a native Linux Secret Service unlock command, provider configuration UI, and chat preflight recovery. Twenty-seven collected credential backend/API cases, ten focused frontend cases, one exact native reference-boundary case, and six catalogued provider-settings browser cases cover the changed boundaries without expanding to unrelated suites.
exclusions: Full suites and unrelated provider, harness, browser-control, and project workflows are excluded. The selected Playwright journey covers desktop Chromium plus 390px Chromium and WebKit provider settings; the native Secret Service prompt itself requires an interactive Linux desktop and is verified separately through the exact native boundary test and manual host workflow. LAN-origin execution is excluded because credential status and recovery use the same Core API on all HTTP origins and native unlock is deliberately unavailable to browsers.
